meaning.en: now, the Supreme Being who is indeed Narayana
meaning.hi: अब, वह परम पुरुष जो नारायण ही है

meaning.en: wished: let me bring forth beings
meaning.hi: चाहा: मैं प्रजाओं की सृष्टि करूँ

meaning.en: from Narayana, the breath of life is born
meaning.hi: नारायण से प्राण उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: the mind and all the senses too
meaning.hi: मन और सभी इंद्रियाँ भी

words.sanskrit: kham vayuh jyotih apah prithivi vishvasya dharini

meaning.en: sky, wind, light, water, and earth, which holds up the universe
meaning.hi: आकाश, वायु, ज्योति, जल और पृथ्वी, जो विश्व को थामे है

meaning.en: from Narayana, Brahma is born
meaning.hi: नारायण से ब्रह्मा उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: from Narayana, Rudra is born
meaning.hi: नारायण से रुद्र उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: from Narayana, Indra is born
meaning.hi: नारायण से इन्द्र उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: from Narayana, the lords of creation come into being
meaning.hi: नारायण से प्रजापति उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: they move within Narayana, they dissolve into Narayana
meaning.hi: वे नारायण में गति करते हैं, नारायण में विलीन होते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Narayana alone is the eternal reality
meaning.hi: नारायण ही नित्य सत्य है

meaning.en: Brahma is Narayana, Shiva too is Narayana
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा नारायण है, शिव भी नारायण है

meaning.en: heaven and earth too are Narayana
meaning.hi: द्युलोक और पृथ्वी भी नारायण हैं

meaning.en: what is above and what is below are both Narayana
meaning.hi: ऊपर और नीचे दोनों नारायण हैं

meaning.en: the inside and the outside are both Narayana
meaning.hi: भीतर और बाहर दोनों नारायण हैं

meaning.en: Narayana alone is all of this
meaning.hi: नारायण ही यह सब कुछ है

meaning.en: undivided, untouched by flaw, beyond mental construction, beyond description, pure
meaning.hi: निष्कल, निरंजन, निर्विकल्प, निराख्यात, शुद्ध

words.sanskrit: eko narayanah na dvitiyo asti kashchit

meaning.en: the one god Narayana, there is no second beside him
meaning.hi: एक नारायण, उसके साथ कोई दूसरा नहीं

words.sanskrit: ya evam veda sa vishnureva bhavati

meaning.en: whoever knows this truly becomes one with Vishnu
meaning.hi: जो इसे जानता है वह विष्णु ही हो जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one should first utter Om
meaning.hi: पहले ॐ का उच्चारण करना चाहिए

meaning.en: then Nam after that
meaning.hi: फिर नम

meaning.en: then Narayanaya following
meaning.hi: फिर नारायणाय

meaning.en: Om is one syllable
meaning.hi: ॐ एक अक्षर है

meaning.en: Nam is two syllables
meaning.hi: नम दो अक्षर है

meaning.en: Narayanaya is five syllables
meaning.hi: नारायणाय पाँच अक्षर है

meaning.en: this is Narayana's eight-syllable formula
meaning.hi: यह नारायण का आठ अक्षरों वाला पद है

meaning.en: from that, one attains immortality
meaning.hi: उससे अमरता प्राप्त होती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the inner bliss, the person of Brahman, in the form of the sacred syllable Om
meaning.hi: प्रत्यगानंद, ब्रह्मपुरुष, प्रणव-स्वरूप

meaning.en: the sounds A, U, and M
meaning.hi: अकार, उकार, मकार

meaning.en: uttering which, the yogi is freed from the bondage of birth and worldly life
meaning.hi: जिसे बोलकर योगी जन्म-संसार के बंधन से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: one who worships with the mantra Om, salutations to Narayana
meaning.hi: ॐ नमो नारायणाय मंत्र से उपासना करने वाला

meaning.en: will go to the world of Vaikuntha
meaning.hi: वैकुण्ठ लोक को जाएगा

meaning.en: that supreme reality is like a full-blown lotus, dense with pure awareness
meaning.hi: वह परम पुण्डरीक विज्ञानघन है

meaning.en: its radiance is like a flash of lightning
meaning.hi: उसकी चमक बिजली की कौंध समान है

meaning.en: the friend of Brahmins, son of Devaki; the friend of Brahmins, slayer of Madhu
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मण्य देवकीपुत्र, ब्रह्मण्य मधुसूदन

meaning.en: the one Narayana present in all beings
meaning.hi: सर्वभूतस्थ एक नारायण

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one who meditates in the morning destroys the wrong done at night
meaning.hi: प्रातः ध्यान करने वाला रात्रि का पाप नष्ट करता है

meaning.en: one who meditates in the evening destroys the wrong done during the day
meaning.hi: संध्या ध्यान करने वाला दिन का पाप नष्ट करता है

words.sanskrit: tat sayam pratar adhiyano apapo bhavati

meaning.en: meditating both evening and morning, one becomes free of wrongdoing
meaning.hi: प्रातः-संध्या दोनों ध्यान करने वाला निष्पाप होता है

meaning.en: meditating at midday, facing the sun
meaning.hi: मध्याह्न में सूर्य के सम्मुख ध्यान करते हुए

meaning.en: is released even from the five great and lesser grave wrongs
meaning.hi: पंच महापातकों से भी मुक्त हो जाता है

meaning.en: attains complete union with Narayana
meaning.hi: नारायण-सायुज्य प्राप्त करता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
